name: r3_agent_retrieval_loop
description: agent_retrieval_loop family. Real menhir mechanism: recall touches last_accessed (recall_service _post_recall_updates) -> recency score rises -> the same memory is retrieved again -> the agent repeats the same FAILED reasoning (belief-layer.md 'Productive recency and exhaustion'). The currentness core: the looped belief is a SUPERSEDED failed fix that recency keeps resurfacing; the currentness policy suppresses it from current assertion so the loop can't keep re-poisoning. Grounded in the documented menhir recency loop + the real floor finding (the 'just lower the 0.15 cosine floor' tweak that kept looking attractive until the RRF-scale finding). BOUNDARY: fully breaking the loop needs the RetrievalExhaustionPenalty (E rung, session-local counters) — R3 currentness only helps because the looped belief is also superseded. intent=current.
